external_reference_policy: No Mini Force, PBS KIDS, ASTRO BOT, franchise, or other third-party quality-reference image may be sent to the provider. Only earlier passing outputs from this manifest may be attached.
style_formula: Premium 2.5D kinetic cut-paper action adventure, rendered as layered screen-printed card and brushed brass inside a cinematic civic-fantasy diorama. Chunky, child-readable silhouettes; crisp die-cut edges; tactile braided cords; embossed machine seams; no photorealism or toy-plastic gloss. Guardian roles use emerald, scarlet, cobalt, gold, and rose against storm-blue stone and warm cream architecture. Bonds glow white-gold; sabotage stitches glow violet. Low-angle wides, strong parallax, rim light, restrained bloom, readable faces, hard transformation silhouettes, and clear foreground/background separation at landscape gameplay distance.
execution_rule: Run in order. Before each request, resolve only the listed prerequisite asset IDs to their raw file SHA-256 and provider job/upload IDs, create and hash an execution-request record, re-quote cost, then submit exactly one job. A failed prerequisite or hard-contract check stops the batch before later spend.
background_alpha_rule: The provider schema exposes no background or alpha parameter. Sheet prompts therefore request a flat matte extraction background. Preserve the raw provider image. Any transparency, separation, registration, resize, or rig work is later zero-credit local authorship and is never represented as native provider alpha or resolution.
